print_type.description:
Document delivery / electronic invoicing mode (default 1): 1 = PDF only; 2 = PDF + CIUS-PT XML,
downloadable through the sale `xml_url`; 3 = CIUS-PT webservice, the XML is sent to Saphety when
the document is finalized. 2 is available to Portuguese companies, 3 only when Saphety CIUS-PT
electronic invoicing is active for the company (422 otherwise). Customers with print_type 2 or 3
must have a full billing address (address, postal_code, city) before documents can be issued.

commitment_number.description:
Default B2G commitment number (LCPA) copied onto new sales documents when the sale
payload omits `document.commitment_number`. Emitted as CIUS-PT BT-19 (cbc:AccountingCost).
Optional, max 50 characters, only meaningful for print_type 2 or 3.

requesting_service.description:
Default B2G requesting service of the public customer, copied onto new sales documents
when the sale payload omits `document.requesting_service`. Emitted as CIUS-PT BT-10
(cbc:BuyerReference). Optional, max 50 characters, only meaningful for print_type 2 or 3.

Queues an asynchronous SAF-T (PT) export for the requested period and

operacoes.descricao: Returns paginated finalized sales documents for the API key dedicated series.

Creates and finalizes a sales document in the API key dedicated series.

Customers configured for electronic invoicing (client `settings.print_type` 2 or 3) must
have a full billing address, otherwise the request fails with 422. For print_type 3 the
CIUS-PT XML is sent to Saphety right after finalization; if that submission fails the
document is still issued (201) and the failure is reported in `meta.integration_warning`
— check `data.electronic_invoice.saphety_status` and resend from the desktop app.

pdf.description: Deprecated and ignored: the response always includes pdf_url, a link that renders the PDF on demand.

email.description:
Optional: email the generated PDF after the document is finalized.
When omitted, no email is sent. When `to` is omitted, the document
client's email is used. Best-effort — a failed send is reported in
the response `meta.email_warning` and does not fail creation.

customer.description:
Customer billed by the sales document. Not required for credit
notes (type NC), whose customer is derived from the credited
source documents.

type.description: Sales document type acronym. Allowed types: FA, FR, FS, NC, GT, GR, FP, ORC. NC = credit note (see items origin_id / origin_line_id); GT/GR = transport guides (require a transport block); FP/ORC = proforma / quote.

series.description: Document series code. The API key dedicated series is used when omitted.

issue_date.description: Document issue date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

auto_confirm.description: Whether the document should be finalized automatically.

warehouse_id.description: Warehouse identifier used for stock movements.

salesman_code.description: Salesman code assigned to the document.

notes.description: Document notes. Use \n to separate lines.

commitment_number.description: B2G commitment number (LCPA), max 50 characters. Sent as CIUS-PT BT-19 cbc:AccountingCost; defaults to the customer's settings.commitment_number when omitted. Optional.

requesting_service.description: B2G requesting service of the public customer, max 50 characters. Sent as CIUS-PT BT-10 cbc:BuyerReference; defaults to the customer's settings.requesting_service when omitted. Optional.

tax_included.description: Whether item prices already include tax.

without_values.description: Transport guides (GT/GR) only: when true, every line is issued with price 0 ("documento sem valores").

items.description:
Sales document lines. For invoices (FA, FR, FS): product_reference, quantity and
unit_price_net are required. For credit notes (NC): each item
instead references a credited source line via origin_id (source
document id from a previous POST /sales response) and
origin_line_id (the items[].id of that document); quantity is
optional and defaults to the line's remaining creditable quantity.

product_reference.description: Product reference sold in this line. Required for invoices; ignored for credit notes.

quantity.description: Quantity. Required for invoices; optional for credit notes (defaults to the line's remaining creditable quantity).

unit_price_net.description: Unit price. Required for invoices/proforma/quote; optional for credit notes (taken from the source line) and transport guides (may be omitted / zeroed via document.without_values).

notes.description: Line notes. Use \n to separate lines.

origin_id.description: Credit note only: source document id (a previous POST /sales `data.id`) whose line is being credited. Required per credited line, but may be omitted for a Desconto/Rappel product line.

origin_line_id.description: Credit note only: source line id (an `items[].id` of the source document). Required per credited line, but may be omitted for a Desconto/Rappel product line.

transport.description:
Transport data for goods movement. Required for transport guides
(GT/GR): both `load` and `delivery` blocks must be complete. The
load `date_time` (movement start) must be at/after now — AT rejects
a past start time.

vehicle_registration.description: Vehicle registration number (optional even for transport guides).

date_time.description: Loading date and time (movement start; must be at/after now for AT).
Delivery date and time (must be on/after the load date).

operacoes.resumo: Download the CIUS-PT XML of a sales document
operacoes.descricao:
Returns the UBL 2.1 CIUS-PT XML of a finalized FA, FR, FS or NC document whose customer
is configured for electronic invoicing (client `settings.print_type` 2 or 3) — the same
file the desktop "download XML (CIUS-PT)" action produces and, for print_type 3, the one
submitted to Saphety. Use the `xml_url` returned by the other sales endpoints; it is null
whenever the XML does not apply to the document.
